scope: Native in-process feed, zero scrollback,120columns×80rows,64KiB chunks,8MiB reviewed corpora; identical reference/candidate snapshot checked before timing. Not application-wide performance parity.
ownership_audit: BudgetSignal has one writer: the terminal owner. All row metadata mutations are crate-private and run on that owner.
Snapshot readers may initialize the separate immutable Charge.value cache; they never adjust the active BudgetSignal.
COW clones preserve capacity and existing charge without adjusting totals; only the owner subsequently mutates the replacement.
Worker-decoded rows are detached from active signals; resize/recycling registration and rebasing remain owner operations.
Atomic storage is retained; only unnecessary locked read-modify-write instructions are replaced with relaxed owner loads/stores. This relies on the documented single-writer invariant.

wide_overwrite_bug.cause: Scalar overwriting an interior wide head interns the erased background style. Bulk replacement of both halves skipped that allocation. Style-table compaction can also make that ordering observable.
wide_overwrite_bug.fix: Preserve scalar order for dynamic metadata or compaction threshold, or when overwritten wide cells may require an erased style absent from the base slot; keep the constant-time common erased-style case batched.
wide_overwrite_bug.regression: history_budget::interior_wide_overwrites_preserve_erased_style_allocation_and_compaction_order covers exact byte limit/None, compression, COW, ASCII/Greek overwrites and compaction at1/7/65536-byte chunks.

limits: Baseline and first two causal variants use the exact earlier measured Unicode source; only the combined candidate is based on c980.
The corrected final candidate remains slower than pinned Ghostty on ASCII and mixed Unicode; no whole-port parity claim.
Reference timings varied between windows; raw samples, medians, source hashes and commands are retained in sibling reports.
No allocator, unsafe code, host frequency setting or clipboard production retry behavior changed.
